title: Hardship and Due-Day Option Limits by Kestrel Finance Tier
content:
Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts offer two schedule options to borrowers: a payment deferral and a change of the monthly due day. Their per-tier limits are set here.

## Payment deferral

| Tier | Deferrals per rolling 12 months | Deferrals over the life of the contract | Installments paid before a first deferral | Maximum days past due at the request | Deferral fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 1 | 2 | 9 | 15 | 35.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 1 | 2 | 6 | 30 | 35.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 1 | 3 | 6 | 30 | 25.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 2 | 4 | 6 | 30 | 25.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 2 | 4 | 6 | 30 | 0.00 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 2 | 4 | 6 | 30 | 0.00 |

## Due-day change

| Tier | Due-day changes over the life of the contract | Maximum days the due day may move later | Installments paid before a due-day change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 1 | 15 | 3 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 1 | 15 | 3 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 1 | 15 | 3 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 2 | 15 | 3 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 2 | 15 | 3 |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 2 | 15 | 3 |

## Comparing the tiers

- Tier E is the most restrictive deferral tier: 9 installments paid first and no more than 15 days past due, against 6 installments and 30 days at every other tier.
- The deferral fee is 35.00 at Tier E and Tier D, 25.00 at Tier C and Tier B, and 0.00 at Tier A and Tier A+.
- Tier B, Tier A and Tier A+ allow 2 deferrals in a rolling 12 months and 4 over the life of the contract; Tier C allows 1 and 3; Tier E and Tier D allow 1 and 2.
- Every tier limits a due-day move to 15 days later and requires 3 installments paid; Tier B and above allow 2 changes over the life of the contract, the lower tiers 1.
